title: Hedgehog wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Hedgehog body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="32" ry="22" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- Spines -->
  <path d="M22 62 Q18 48 28 44 Q24 36 34 36 Q32 26 42 30 Q44 20 52 26 Q58 18 62 28 Q70 22 72 34 Q82 30 80 42 Q88 42 82 52 Q88 60 78 62 Z" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <!-- Spine highlights -->
  <path d="M26 58 Q24 48 32 46" stroke="#A0714F" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M40 44 Q38 34 46 34" stroke="#A0714F" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M56 32 Q60 26 64 34" stroke="#A0714F" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M70 42 Q76 38 76 46" stroke="#A0714F" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Face -->
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="72" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="68" r="3" fill="#1E1E2E"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="68" r="3" fill="#1E1E2E"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="67" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="67" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="74" r="2.5" fill="#3D1F0F"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M64 76 Q68 79 72 76" stroke="#3D1F0F" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="58" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="58" rx="2" ry="3" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <path d="M36 40 L44 12 L58 34 Z" fill="#FF4D6D"/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <path d="M39 32 L49 20" stroke="#FFD166" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M42 26 L52 16" stroke="#4CD964" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M46 20 L53 14" stroke="#5B9BFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Hat pom pom -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="10" r="3.5" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <rect x="34" y="37" width="26" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FF4D6D"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="90" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="90" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
</svg>
